summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buy-back program announced on 5 August 2026. On 6 August 2026, it purchased 446,000 ordinary shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange through BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC at a volume-weighted average price of HK$158.7150 per share (range HK$157.7000–HK$159.9000), for a total consideration of approximately US$9 million. Shares were purchased for cancellation, reducing issued capital. No repurchases occurred on UK venues. Watch for continued buy-back execution and potential accretion to EPS as shares are retired.
